_note: Per-category rules appended to the stage-2 prompt. Edit the "rule" text -- an empty rule means this category uses the shared prompt unchanged, which is the right default. A rule can only change HOW the 18 contract fields are filled; the schema is closed, so there is nowhere to put a new field. The only free-text field is lineItems[].description. A category may also carry "sumTollTickets": true, which turns on src/tolls.py for that code -- a trip's expressway tickets are then summed into one row, photocopies dropped by their running number. That is behaviour, not prompt text, so it is a flag here rather than a sentence in "rule": the parsing itself lives in Python and cannot sensibly be expressed in this file. The flag lives here so the account code is written down once.
_codeFormat: Account codes are keyed as digits only, no dashes: 5122100, not 5-122-100. Decided 2026-08-20. Lookups are normalised by category_key() in src/stage2_extract.py, so the webapp may send either spelling, or the code with its Thai label attached, and the right rule still fires. Keep new keys in the digits-only form so this file stays consistent.
_source: Account codes transcribed from FA's three lists, 2026-08-11. VERIFY THE DIGITS against FA's own file before relying on them -- they were read off screenshots, and a wrong digit means a rule silently never fires. CORRECTED 2026-08-24 against FA's own FM-FA-05 form: 5213100, 5213300 and 5234100 were missing entirely from the screenshot transcription and have been added.
_uncertain: Names I could not read cleanly and guessed at: 6212100, 6253200, 6273100, 5235100. The codes are legible; only the Thai names are in doubt.

5122100.group: ค่าใช้จ่ายโครงการ
5122100.name: ค่าแรง
5122100.rule:
This category is usually paid on a ใบรับเงิน, which pays a person rather than a shop. When the document is one:
- payeeType is "individual" and sellerBranch is null. A person has no branch.
- The seller is the person under ข้อมูลผู้รับเงิน (บุคคลธรรมดา). ชื่อ-นามสกุล is sellerName, ที่อยู่ is sellerAddress, and the 13 digits beside เลขประจำตัวประชาชน are sellerTaxId. Read these from the handwriting and lower the confidence rather than leaving them null.
- The buyer is the company under ข้อมูลผู้จ่ายเงิน (บริษัท).
- The money table has three columns. จำนวนเงิน is the gross and is both amountBeforeVat and originalTotal. ภาษีหัก ณ ที่จ่าย is withholdingTax. จำนวนเงินที่จ่าย - สุทธิ is clearingAmount.
- This form carries no VAT. vat and vatRate are null. Never copy the withholding tax into vat; they are different taxes.
5122100.evidence: ค่าจ้าง ค่าแรง บุคคลธรรมดา ใช้ใบเสร็จของบริษัท + แนบสำเนาบัตรประชาชน + Slip เงินโอน

_faSource: VAT and withholding columns transcribed from FA's แบบฟอร์มเคลียร์ Adv Project.csv (FM-FA-05 ป.3), received 2026-08-24. `vat` and `withholdingTaxRate` are FA's policy for the category -- what SHOULD apply -- not a claim about what any one document prints. The extractor still reports only what it can read. Use them to flag a mismatch for review, never to overwrite a value.
_withholdingGeneral: FA's general withholding table: ค่าซื้อสินค้า none · ค่าขนส่ง 1% · ค่าโฆษณา 2% · ค่าจ้าง/ค่าแรง/ค่าบริการ 3% · ค่าเช่า 5%. NOTE: FA also states withholding applies only once payments to that supplier pass 1,000 THB for the year. That is a per-supplier annual running total and is NOT visible on a single page, so neither the model nor any guard here can apply it -- the webapp or FA must.

5213100.group: ค่าใช้จ่ายสำนักงาน
5213100.name: ค่าเช่าอาคารสำนักงาน
5213100.evidence: ค่าเช่า ใบเสร็จ/ใบกำกับภาษี (ใช้ Vat) หรือบิลเงินสด (ไม่มี Vat)
5213100.rule: A ใบกำกับภาษี from a VAT-registered seller shows 7% VAT; a บิลเงินสด from an ordinary shop shows none. Report only what the document prints. If the document deducts withholding tax, FA's rate for this category is 5%. Report withholdingTaxRate and withholdingTax only when the document states them -- do not calculate either.
